intent: fix(security): prevent credentials from surviving structured execution logs
body: The shared redactor now understands credential fields and JSON member values, preserves ordinary diagnostic bytes, and masks native credentials before daemon preview truncation. Existing capability coverage is retained.
trailers: Constraint: Keep existing API signatures and dependency graph
Rejected: Global dynamic secret registry | requires a separate task lifecycle and streaming contract
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: moderate
Directive: Redact complete tool output before preview truncation; keep structured and textual cases aligned
Tested: Focused redaction, race, fake daemon transcript and provider regressions; independent review
Not-tested: Cross-event streaming, historical log cleanup and real providers

intent: fix(ci): require working database setup before accepting test results
body: Release verification provisions the declared test database and Redis before migrations and full Go tests. Database-backed TestMain failures cannot be reported as passing tests, while unconfigured testutil may run its explicit pure-helper subset.
trailers: Constraint: Never access an implicit developer database during verification
Rejected: Treat unreachable database as skipped success | hides missing execution
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Directive: Preserve independent probe timeouts and require named-test evidence for full acceptance
Tested: Offline actual-binary matrix, wrapper and workflow regressions, package vet and independent review
Not-tested: Healthy database fixtures, seed fault injection and hosted Release execution

intent: fix(squads): align delivery guidance with acceptance and review requirements
body: Generated instructions now distinguish delivering a child issue from accepting it. Review Gate leader routing covers all six existing specialist roles, with matching skills, bilingual summaries and embedded documentation.
trailers: Constraint: Human or existing integration acceptance still owns done
Rejected: Automatically advance every in_review child | changes the acceptance boundary
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Directive: Existing customized role instances are not upgraded by changing template defaults
Tested: Generated workflow and role/skill contract tests, docs generation/embed, vet and independent review
Not-tested: Real-model instruction following, database stage events and existing instance migration

intent: docs(agents): preserve the improvement roadmap and first P1 evidence
body: Capture the phased roadmap, source-grounded audit and retained red/green evidence for the first prioritized repairs so later permission, evidence, reporting and nonfunctional work can continue without re-opening settled scope.
trailers: Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Directive: M1-M3 remain planned; local scoped tests are not hosted deployment acceptance
Tested: Task manifests, source review hashes and artifact references
Not-tested: Future roadmap capabilities
Directive: Retained raw process logs and probe source preserve original bytes, including whitespace
